concepts.definition: a paper or digital template representing garment pieces used as a guide for cutting fabric
a line where two or more pieces of fabric are joined by stitching
a finished lower edge made by turning and securing fabric to prevent fraying and improve appearance
a stitched fold that removes excess fabric to shape a garment to body contours
the direction of the fabric yarns that guides correct placement of garment pattern pieces
a dimension taken from the body and used to draft, select, or alter garment patterns
a material made from fibres, yarns, or fabrics for clothing and other uses
the controlled separation of fabric into garment pieces according to a pattern layout
a mechanical or electronic device that forms stitches to join or finish fabric
final operations that improve a garment's neatness, durability, fit, and presentation
